/projects.title: Rihla Tour & Travels – Tour Packages & Booking Enquiries
/projects.short_description: A polished travel website for Rihla Tour & Travels, presenting tour packages and letting travellers send booking enquiries online.
/projects.challenge: Rihla needed a professional online presence to showcase its tour packages and turn browsing travellers into booking enquiries, instead of depending on social media messages.
/projects.solution: We designed and built a fast, mobile-friendly website with a package catalogue, destination pages and a simple enquiry flow, plus an admin panel for the team to publish and update tours.
/projects.result: Travellers can browse packages and request a booking from any device, and Rihla's team can keep its offers up to date without technical help.

/projects.title: Natik Language Centre – Course Catalogue & Enrollment Platform
/projects.short_description: A modern website and enrollment platform for Natik Language Centre, helping learners explore language courses and register online.
/projects.challenge: Natik teaches languages to a diverse community of learners, but course details, schedules and registrations were handled manually through calls and messages. That was slow for the centre's staff and confusing for prospective students.
/projects.solution: We built a clean, multi-language website with a clear course catalogue, class schedules and online enrollment, plus an admin panel so the centre's team can manage courses, intakes and registrations without needing a developer.
/projects.result: Prospective students can explore courses and register in minutes from any device, and the centre's team spends less time answering repeat enquiries and more time teaching.

/projects.title: HT Travel Agency – Travel Booking & Visa Assistance Platform
/projects.short_description: A modern travel agency platform designed to help travelers from Addis Ababa discover destinations and arrange flights, hotels, visa assistance, and complete travel plans through a simple digital experience.
/projects.challenge: Traditional travel booking can be time-consuming, especially when customers need to manage flights, hotels, visas, and trip planning separately. HT Travel needed a modern online presence that could make its services easier to discover while building trust with travelers.
/projects.solution: We developed a modern and responsive travel agency website that brings destinations, travel services, trip planning, visa assistance, and customer communication into one simple experience. The platform presents HT Travel as a trusted travel partner while making it easy for visitors to explore destinations and start planning their trip.
/projects.result: Delivered a professional digital platform that strengthens HT Travel Agency's online presence, clearly communicates its services, showcases destinations, and gives travelers a simple way to begin planning their next trip.

/projects.title: StudentBridge Donation Platform
/projects.short_description: Donation and campaign management platform with modern UI/UX workflows for supporting student financial needs.
/projects.full_description: Developed a donation and campaign management platform with modern UI/UX workflows, donor management, and campaign analytics.
/projects.challenge: Empowering direct transparency and simple digital donation channels for student financial aid.
/projects.solution: Designed an accessible visual donation platform with secure payment integrations and live campaign progress metrics.
/projects.result: Connected hundreds of students with essential educational funding through streamlined visual donation workflows.

/projects.title: Chala Mobile – E-Commerce Repair Management System
/projects.short_description: Business management platform for a real mobile retail client with inventory management, repair tracking, dashboards, and PDF receipt generation.
/projects.full_description: Developed a business management platform for a real mobile retail client. Implemented inventory management, repair tracking, dashboards, and PDF receipt generation. Integrated authentication, payment systems, and customer management workflows.
/projects.challenge: Manual repair tracking led to customer status miscommunication and inventory discrepancies.
/projects.solution: Built an integrated POS and repair lifecycle management portal featuring automated SMS updates and live PDF receipt rendering.
/projects.result: Streamlined mobile repair turnover by 45% and established real-time inventory tracking for multiple retail branches.

/projects.title: ShegerEvent – Event Management Platform
/projects.short_description: Full-stack event ecosystem supporting organizers, attendees, admins, and security staff with QR ticket validation and Chapa payments.
/projects.full_description: Integrated QR-based ticket validation, analytics dashboards, and payment workflows. Built using React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, and Chapa payment integration.
/projects.challenge: Managing high-throughput ticket sales and instant QR gate verification during major live events.
/projects.solution: Engineered a full-stack event infrastructure with real-time QR scanner endpoints, admin telemetry dashboards, and automated payment callbacks.
/projects.result: Successfully validated tens of thousands of event tickets with sub-second gate scanning latency and 100% payment reconciliation.

/blog.title: Architecting Resilient Multi-Tenant Relational Databases
/blog.excerpt: A deep dive into indexing strategies, connection pooling, and row-level security isolation in enterprise relational systems.
/blog.content:
## Introduction
When engineering enterprise software platforms, database architecture dictates application reliability. Multi-tenancy introduces unique isolation, scaling, and query optimization challenges.

### Indexing Strategies
Indexes are critical for query optimization. By creating composite index keys on tenant identifiers and timestamp filters, relational engines drastically reduce full table scans.
